domain_findings: Mockup search spans template-based POD tools, Photoshop smart-object workflows and AI-generated product scenes. The article addresses the gap between a plausible scene and controlled existing artwork.
Do not confuse print visualization with a manufacturing proof or fulfillment integration.
Include precise controls and corrective actions rather than an unmeasured product superiority claim.
No claim of guaranteed search ranking, conversion lift, perfect fidelity, automatic SKU mapping, PSD export or physical measurements.
